挂载资源节点
```
  curl -X POST 'http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/catalog/resource/bind' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'api-key: {api_key}' \
    -H 'sensorsdata-project: {projectName}' \
    -d '{
      "parent_name": "8998a014-f8e3-4d8a-8b2c-ec7beeeefc97",
      "resource_type": "TAG",
      "resource_id":"user_tag_bq_meta_string"
  }'
  返回值示例：
  {
    "code": "SUCCESS",
    "request_id": "1217080591f8f9e3d9b6d24e8a43ee8c",
    "data": {}
  }
```

解绑资源节点
```
  curl -X POST 'http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/catalog/resource/unbind' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'api-key: {api_key}' \
    -H 'sensorsdata-project: {projectName}' \
    -d '{
    "business_type": "ENTITY",
    "business_name": "user",
    "resource_type": "TAG",
    "resource_id": "user_tag_bq_meta_string"
  }'
  返回值示例：
  {
    "code": "SUCCESS",
    "request_id": "121717050a1c695fb26a0f298252ba28",
    "data": {}
  }
```
